user.title: Jebao Pump Setup
user.description:
Choose how to add your Jebao pump to Home Assistant.

**Automatic discovery** - Scan your network for pumps (recommended)
**Manual configuration** - Enter IP address if you know it

discover.title: Network Discovery

data.interfaces: Network interfaces to scan (leave all selected if unsure)

select_device.title: Select Device
select_device.description:
Found {device_count} Jebao pump(s) on your network.

Select a pump to add to Home Assistant. Each pump shows its device ID and IP address.

manual.title: Manual Setup
manual.description:
{discovery_result}

Enter the IP address of your Jebao pump.

The pump must be powered on and connected to the same network as Home Assistant. Port 12416 must be accessible.

Example: 192.168.1.100

confirm_discovery.title: Discovered Jebao Pump

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to pump. Check the IP address and ensure the pump is powered on.
error.discovery_failed: Discovery failed. Try manual configuration or check your network settings.

init.title: Jebao Options
init.description:
Pump model: nothing on the network tells these models apart (they report the same product key, and the Jebao app doesn't know the model either), so set it here.

Status update interval: lower values provide more responsive updates but increase network traffic. Recommended: 30 seconds (default).

Keep the pump clock set: the pump's schedule runs on its own clock, which only the app's "Set Time" sets. With this on, Home Assistant sets it at startup, daily at 03:17, and before starting the schedule.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replaces the pump's daily schedule (up to 48 time slots) and optionally turns it on or off. Slots must not overlap; one that ends before it starts runs past midnight.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: List of slots: start and end (HH:MM, end may be 24:00), mode (run, feed or off; default run) and speed (30-100, for run slots; default 100). An empty list clears the schedule.

enable.name: Enable
enable.description: Turn the schedule on (true) or off (false) afterwards. Leave out to keep it as it is.
